text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
This place sounds good～!
There's 30 Miles of freedom! 
……and this one,
has about 20 Miles of thrills.

It was a few days before Summer Training Camp.
Today, the two of 
us were planning on how to spend the one
day off we would get.

After scrolling,
I turned my laptop towards her.
I had found some 
leisure-related facilities that would be
near the training camp.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ah! 
This mark, the Mile rewards……!?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Amazing! +100 Miles, Trainer-san! 
……On our day off, let's go here!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-saaaan,
here I go! Get the camera ready! 
——One, two!
(SPLASH!)

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Puha-! The water slide was fun! 
It gets you really pumped up!
Maybe 50 Miles worth!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san! Next,
let's do that one together! 
『Carrot Boat★Rendezvous』!

Gran Alegria and I were enjoying summer to
the fullest. 
Swimming, floating, diving,
we enjoyed it all……

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Mmm～～～～! 
This salad is 100 Miles of
deliciousness……!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Crunchy,
leafy lettuce mixed with brightly colored
green and yellow 
veggies! Fried onions for texture and flavor!
It's perfect!
choice_data_list: This is good too, 120 Miles worth!
This is good too, 120 Miles worth!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Eeh, that good!? 
……After finishing this MiRule meal,
I'll try ordering that!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
……Puha～～! I ate a lot～! 
With this,
I'll have Infinite Miles-worth of energy!

While watching her finish her dessert
frappe, 
I pulled a memopad out of my bag.
choice_data_list: Let's see, the Miles I've earned……

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
! Trainer-san, that memopad,
is it perhaps……

I nodded in response to Gran Alegria's
expectant gaze. 
……That's right.
It was the same as her 『Mile Memo』!
choice_data_list: Just using a phone is boring

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ah-! I get that feeling!
There's a sense of excitement when
writing 
by hand and a sense of accomplishment when
reading through it!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Fufuu! 
Trainer-san,
you're already a proper Miler now too,
huh!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Just like this,
we'll keep the fun coming, and save up 
those Miles!
Because this is a great place to build up
the Miles!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Then, next up is……yeah!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
『Tropical Vacation Area』!
We've played a lot, 
so next let's take it easy with some Vacation
Time!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Waah……!
choice_data_list: It's like we're really down south!
It's like we're really down south!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! 100……no! 
It's 1000 Miles of surprising!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
It seems like it's modeled after a real
overseas resort! 
It was written in the pamphlet!
choice_data_list: Oooh, so it's a real place!
Oooh, so it's a real place!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
If it's 1000 Miles of surprise here then……how
many Miles do 
you think the real thing will be?
It makes you wonder, doesn't it!?

For a rookie trainer like me…… 
There'd be all kinds of hurdles.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Hmmm, you think so? 
If the two of us go together,
I don't think it'll be that hard!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: After all, we've got Miles don't we!?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
With two peoples' worth of Miles,
we could definitely go! 
When it comes to English,
I can act as a translator!

——It was the day I learned that Gran Alegria
was saving 
up her Miles.
I was pretty sure she said this——

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
? Yeah! 
If I spend them, there'll be less of them!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Except maybe when they're about to expire,
I guess? 
But, not until the very end!
Otherwise they'll decrease!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Of course, even now that won't change! 
But, you see……

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
If I'm together with Trainer-san then,
it might be fine. 
I started thinking I wanted to spend them.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Because……that's where MiLove is!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Yeah, MiLove!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Do you remember? Before, 
when Trainer-san used your Miles to treat
me to that cake.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
That day,
it's true that Trainer-san's Miles
disappeared. 
But……they still remain with me here.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san's MiLove,
『It's the materialization of all 
those Miles』.
It took on the form of these feelings and
remained!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
……Miles change their form.
Those that love Miles, 
are thankful of those Miles,
the moment they use those Miles——

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
It becomes something you can't see, 
that remains in your heart, and——

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
They become Miles that will never
disappear!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
That's why,
let's go to that Southern Island!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
For all the hard work we do,
a vacation reward! Everything 
we've gathered together,
the materialization of that MiLove!

Her words left a warm feeling in my
chest. 
Before I realized it, I was nodding.
choice_data_list: Yeah, we'll go someday for sure!
Yeah, we'll go someday for sure!

text_block_list.text:
It may take us a while, 
but someday, definitely……

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
No matter how long it takes,
it'll be fine!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
After all,
even if I graduate from Tracen Academy, 
the Miles will still be there.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
The bond created by those Miles, 
between Trainer-san and me, will be there!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
So there's no expiration date on this
promise!
